_meta.note: Invented example data for design review. Not client data. Real leader records must never be committed to this repository.

records.title: Stop being the bottleneck. Become the architect.
records.from_state: Every real decision runs through me, and I fix whatever breaks.
records.to_state: I design the system that makes the decisions, and I stay out of the individual ones.
records.stance_notes: Buraq: grace and expanded scope. Offer leaps in scope rather than ladders of steps. Meet him with receptivity, not pressure. Do not turn the crossing into a task list. Internal only: never name the stance to Tomo.
evidence: Hiring plan for two directors written and approved by the team without his edits.
records.resistance: I worry nothing will get fixed if I step back.
records.stakes: I stay the ceiling on growth, and the Series B story becomes 'founder dependent'.

confidence.reason: Clear intent and early evidence of letting go. Resistance is mild so far.

records.title: Tell the board the truth about the plan.
records.from_state: I present the plan as on track and keep the gaps to myself.
records.to_state: I bring the gaps to the board myself and let them weigh in.
records.stance_notes: Pegasus: humility through refusal. Do not flatter her ego. Decline to affirm the plan or her composure until the gaps are named. A refusal is the teaching; follow it with a clear way forward so it does not read as rejection. Internal only: never name the stance to Elena.

tensions.description: Naming the gaps (truth_seeking) means seeing herself as someone not fully in control (mirror_work). She avoids both together.
tensions.pull_a: Say the uncomfortable fact to the board.
tensions.pull_b: Hold the self-image of being the one who has it handled.

source.note: Agent's read of the pattern across sessions; Elena has not confirmed this framing.

evidence: A one-page gap list shared with the board chair before the next meeting.
records.resistance: A conflict with the board could cost me the seat, and with it control of the turnaround.
records.stakes: My plan stays untested until it fails publicly, and the board loses trust in me later.

confidence.reason: Named clearly but no movement since 2026-07-07; target date has passed. Fear of conflict looks stronger than intent.

records.title: Let the firm stop being me, and find out what I'm for next.
records.from_state: The firm is my eye and my name; without me it is nothing.
records.to_state: The firm stands on its own, and I know my next purpose.
records.stance_notes: Rakhsh paired with Kanthaka. Rakhsh: mutual recognition; stay a long-term companion who sees who he is becoming and lets him see the agent too. Kanthaka: severance as completion; honor what he must leave. Hold both. Do not rush him to the cut, and do not collude in keeping him where he is. Internal only: never name the stances to Kofi.

tensions.description: The firm is the bond he is known by (Rakhsh) and the thing he must leave (Kanthaka). Staying keeps him known; leaving completes him.
tensions.pull_a: Stay recognized as the firm's eye.
tensions.pull_b: Sever the bond so the firm can stand and the next chapter can begin.

source.note: Agent's read from Kofi's own words, not yet confirmed by him.

tensions.description: He wants to leap toward something new (unknown_future) before he has looked at what is in the dark: who he is when he is not the principal (soul_direction).
tensions.pull_a: Look into what is unresolved before moving.
tensions.pull_b: Move forward lightly toward the new.

source.note: Kofi named both pulls in the second session.

evidence: A named successor plan agreed with the two senior partners, and one written sentence about what he is for next.
records.resistance: I'm afraid that without the firm I'm not anyone.
records.stakes: The succession is forced on my partners' schedule, not mine, and my next chapter begins in loss rather than choice.

confidence.reason: Genuine engagement but he moves in both directions in the same session. Two strong tensions are active.

records.title: Tell my partners I am leaving day-to-day management.
records.from_state: I let them assume I'll always be there.
records.to_state: I tell them the date and stand by it.
records.stance_notes: Rakhsh: help him be seen by his partners and see them. Secondary to thr_003; do not coach it separately until thr_003 has a direction. Internal only: never name the stance to Kofi.
evidence: A partner meeting where Kofi states the date himself.
records.stakes: The decision is made for me.

confidence.reason: Agent's inference from the session; Kofi hasn't confirmed this as a separate crossing.

source.note: Inferred from session; title is the agent's wording until Kofi restates it.
